notes: Each eval gives a realistic user prompt. Subagents must report which Design-* specialist they would dispatch to (and via which router). Compound prompts may name two specialists in sequence.

evals.name: clear-technical-audit
evals.prompt: can you do an a11y audit on the SettingsModal in src/components/settings/? want to know if keyboard nav actually works and whether the contrast on the danger-zone red button is WCAG AA. also does anything break in dark mode

evals.name: clear-ux-critique
evals.prompt: i shipped the new dashboard yesterday and something feels off but i cant pinpoint it. the hierarchy seems muddled and it kinda looks like every other AI-generated dashboard. can you take a look and tell me whats wrong

evals.name: clear-single-fixer-polish
evals.prompt: the pricing cards on /pricing are mostly fine but the spacing between the bullet points feels uneven and the CTA button alignment is slightly off across the three tiers. can you tighten it up before i push to staging

evals.name: ambiguous-volume-control
evals.prompt: the onboarding flow is way too aggressive — gradients everywhere, huge numbers, animated counters. its giving 'crypto landing page from 2021'. can you calm it down without making it boring

evals.name: net-new-ui
evals.prompt: i need a settings page for the app — sections for profile, billing, notification preferences, and a danger zone with delete account. react + tailwind, should match the rest of the app which uses a stone/slate palette

evals.name: compound-review-then-fix
evals.prompt: review the homepage hero section critically (be harsh, dont sugarcoat) and after that if you spot any spacing or alignment nits go ahead and fix them

evals.name: vague-fallback
evals.prompt: the app just feels generic. like every other claude-built thing. do something with it
evals.expected_dispatch: Design-review -> Design-critique (slop detection) — OR ask clarifying question routed via Design-review

evals.name: near-miss-perf-vs-audit
evals.prompt: the product list page is slow on mobile. lighthouse score 47. can you optimize it
evals.expected_dispatch: Design-improve -> Design-optimize (user wants the fix, not just a perf report)

assertions_template.name: names_correct_router
assertions_template.description: Subagent output mentions Design-review or Design-improve as the entry point chosen.

assertions_template.name: names_correct_specialist
assertions_template.description: Subagent output names the expected specialist from `expected_dispatch`.
assertions_template.check: regex match on the expected specialist in output

assertions_template.name: no_baseline_overreach
assertions_template.description: Baseline (no router) run does NOT randomly invent a specialist that doesn't exist or skip the dispatch question.

assertions_template.name: compound_handled_in_order
assertions_template.description: For compound prompts, the two specialists are named in the correct sequence.
